task_instructions: Serializing mock.call objects with to_jsonable_python raises TypeError: '_Call' object is not an instance of 'SchemaSerializer'. This occurs because accessing __pydantic_serializer__ on unittest.mock.call returns another mock rather than raising AttributeError. Ensure that serializer fallback logic safely handles objects whose __pydantic_serializer__ attribute is not a valid SchemaSerializer.
expected_behavior: When an object has an invalid or non-SchemaSerializer __pydantic_serializer__ attribute, to_jsonable_python must delegate to the fallback callable rather than terminating with a TypeError.
